mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.5% (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS < 1.5% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 4.0% (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates a tight labor market that supports strong consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in UNRATE < 4.0% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is low (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) and inflation is low (CPIAUCSL < 2.5% year-over-year), the market perceives stable economic conditions with room for policy support, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in triggering periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDP growth > 2.0% annualized and CPIAUCSL < 3.0% year-over-year), the economy approaches peak without immediate recessionary pressures, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in late-cycle periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The level of real GDP (GDPC1) reflects economic activity size; higher GDP levels correlate with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 is above its 5-year average.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105.0 (INDPRO > 105.0) indicates strong manufacturing output and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in INDPRO > 105.0 periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth exceeds 100,000 jobs per month (PAYEMS > 100000) and unemployment is below 4.0% (UNRATE < 4.0%), the robust labor market supports consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in triggering periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising at least 0.5% in 3 months), higher interest rates reduce liquidity and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in tightening cycles are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
